candidates.review_text: We were very pleased to get a lovely booth when we arrived. Our server was excellent and the food terrific. The restaurant is very attractive and inviting. However, the restaurant is SO NOISY that we had difficulty conversing and enjoying our meal. There was loud rock like music on the sound system which does not go with such a fine restaurant. In addition there were large groups nearby that added to the noise. It is unfortunate and we would never return. The Prices are VERY high. It is just not worth it.

The food was excellent, the waiter was excellent.  Our issue was with the noise level.  It was difficult for my wife and I to have a conversation.  It was a combination of the decor (hardwood floors) and the other restaurant patrons.  We we surrounded with loud-mouthed diners, who spoke far too loud.  The restaurant needs to move and not tell the current patrons where they are going.  We would go back for the food and service, but are reluctant due to the clientele.

The food here is wonderful.
The restaurant itself is very small.
If you are planning to have a conversation over dinner, this is not your place. It can get very loud in there and the tabels are very close together.
The food is great though - so it's worth the experience.

Had my first El Vez experience this Friday and I will definitely be back! Got to the restaurant a few minutes before our reservation so we waited a few minutes for our table to be ready. I definitely recommend making a reservation if you're coming on a weekend night. Our waitress was wonderful! She got our drinks immediately after we arrived and was around to put in our order as soon as we were ready. I love Mexican and the food at El Vez was out of this world. We ordered the grilled beef tacos, mahi mahi tacos, and shrimp tacos. We also got sides of the creamy poblano corn rice, recommended by our waitress, and the rice & beans. The tacos were some of the best I've ever had. Don't even get me started on the corn rice. It was one of the most amazing things I've ever eaten and I was so glad I took her recommendation. Yes the restaurant is noisy but honestly, do you really expect to sit in a quiet restaurant on a weekend night? I did have to speak above my normal volume but I still didn't feel like I was shouting. I will definitely be back to El Vez, and soon!

Holy shit this place get's wayyy too loud. If the inside is even close to full don't bother. You probably won't be able to hear a word your friends are saying unless they yell. From now on I will only eat inside if it is close to empty. Either stop playing music that will make people talk louder or get some sound absorbent materials in place. Looking at other reviews I'm not the only one that has been put off by this issue...

PS- Get the hell off my lawn!!
Good food but VERY NOISY. I could not hear my dinner companion. Went home with a huge headache, but food and drinks were good.

Great food. Even better drinks. Music is way too loud. Like, I-can-barely-hear-my-thoughts loud.... No, seriously. Not a good spot if you want to catch up with friends. REEEAAALLLY LOUD!! But food, drinks and service are really good.
Great atmosphere, food and drinks. We were sitting upstairs and it was really quiet which was great cause we could easily talk. Everyone was really nice to us, no complaints

I frequent this establishment on a monthly basis. I bring friends and clients to this center city sports bar/restaurant. I've been coming to this location for years for the great food. Marcia the hostess is fantastic and a wonderful person. The rest of the staff is on point as well. I only come here for lunch. Misconduct is one of my favorite lunch spots in the city. I actually went there and had lunch with friends 3 times this week. However I have one complaint. During lunch the majority of the clientele are business people from around the area. They want to be able to eat and chat. But for the longest time there is some idiot that works there and insists on playing the background music TOO LOUD. It's lunchtime. Not a damn nightclub. I love the food and the staff but the stupid loud music is enough to stop me from coming here ever again. I hope someone in charge reads this and turns the music down. It ruins the lunch experience when you have to yell over the too loud music to communicate with the person you're dining with.

The food is great and there are many choices, but it is very loud.  Tables are very close together and the spaces between them are hard to walk through.  The lady sitting next to me almost knocked over my glass while trying to get to her seat.

Food = DELICIOUS
Service = hilarious
Noise level = DEAFENING

Loved this place but REALLY loud and really dark. I get that that is what they're going for. It has a unique feel. The food is unique too. I just didn't expect it to be SO LOUD. It's almost impossible to have a conversation.

A restaurant all about chocolate?  Heaven!  Don't get me wrong, there are non-chocolate items on the menu such as bacon mac and cheese or pizza but chocolate is the standout here.  My absolute favorite is the Brenner Burger which features the house BBQ sauce (pretty sure there's cocoa powder in there!) and onion rings and is served with the best french fries I've ever had.  I cannot say enough about these fries...waffle fries, perfectly crisp and dusted with cocoa and chili powder.  They are heavenly.  The chocolate milk is rich and creamy.  The tiramisu is nothing short of perfection.  Beware of the milkshakes and dessert waffles...they are intensely sweet.  

There is a gift shop which serves delicious, melt-in-your-mouth chocolates in the most exquisite packaging I've ever seen.

The only reason that this restaurant doesn't get 5 stars is because of the ambiance.  The restaurant is clean and beautifully decorated.  However, it is cramped and VERY loud.  These are the only pitfalls but not bothersome enough to stop be from coming back again and again!
The food and service here are outstanding. Only complaint is it is very noisy. Great menu and knowledgeable server really made the meal enjoyable.

There were 6 of us for dinner last night and the food and service was wonderful.  Unfortunately the restaurant noise was so loud we could not hear each other, ended up passing on dessert as we could not stand the noise.

Amazing food, great beer selection, excellent service. That's all you need, right?

We went for brunch, first off I was so excited to see beignets on the menu! We got them to start and they did not disappoint. We also tried the pralined bacon - it was a tad too sweet for my taste, but you will not be disappointed if you try it! My boyfriend got the pancakes, and they came covered in slices of fresh strawberries, bananas, and blueberries. I tried the oyster, bacon, and spinach omelette, which came with the best grits I've had north of the Mason-Dixon Line and a ginormous biscuit. 

Now the downside: price and atmosphere. It's a bit of a pricey menu, and I think it's worth it only if you get a New Orleans dish (that's the theme! You can get pancakes anywhere in the city, get something different).  The atmosphere was kind of divey, the dining room was clean but very dark and dungeon like. The music was too loud and we had a hard time hearing our server, and the acoustics amplified the ambient noise. If the review was based on food and service, I would give it 5 stars!

Large selections of tapas like foods, we tried so many different things. Food and service were both quite great.

It is very, very loud though, so don't expect to be able to have a conversation easily.

Parc was interesting.
The host staff was extremely anxious while my friend and I were dining on Friday night - this provided for a good bit of attention.  I wish I could say the same for the wait staff.  I'm really not sure if our waiter was in charge of 1900 other tables, or if it just took him 32 minutes to cross the massive dining room each time he went to the kitchen, at any rate, the service was very slow.  If you're going to Parc, you need two full hours dedicated to it.
The food was cooked perfectly. We started with escargot and then, had salmon and trout almondine. Yumm. I can't speak for my friend's dessert, but I had the Nougat Glacé.  It was like a soft, frozen Torrone. I called my Italian father immediately and told him about it. Again, yumm. 
Other bummer: it's very loud - you don't notice it at first, but it gets progressively harder to communicate with your table as the night goes on.

I have always enjoyed the food and drinks at this place. I like the large salads and small desserts. The hostesses and servers have been courteous and attentive. Often, the music was way too loud. I don't like having to shout to have a conversation. If it weren't for that problem, I would go there more often.

This place was fine when my friend and I were the only ones in the restaurant; then when the place began to fill up it became so loud that it was truly unbearable.  It was so noisy that we had to shout at each other from across our two-top and eventually stopped our conversation altogether. Mediocre food, mediocre service, unacceptably loud.  Will not be returning.

Summary:  Great food, inattentive servers, and a noise level that ruined any sense of pleasure for the evening.  I will not return.

I'll start by saying the food was excellent. The physical facility is beautiful.  And since it is a BYO restaurant, I could bring some really wonderful and appropriate bottles from my cellar.

But... The sound level inside the restaurant completely destroyed the meal.  The walls are hard, the ceiling is hard, the tables are hard, the giant glass window is hard, wonderful reflectors of every bit of noise in the room.  The total space is divided in half by a long wall, also increasing the noise.

It was DEAFENING!  My ears were clogged by the end of the meal, as if I had been to a rock concert.  You had to practically shout to be heard across your table.

Restaurants like higher sound levels as it makes it seem more "alive".  This was so far over the top -- the agony of the noise made it difficult to interact or appreciate the food.

The service was so-so.  Pleasant, knowledgeable, and completely inattentive.  We had to flag down one server (took several minutes) to get a second wine bottle opened.  He would not do it, it has to be done by "our" server, several more minutes.

I will not return to Melograno.  I cannot enjoy a a meal under these conditions.

Had no problems getting in on a weekday at 6. We went early to avoid the reported deafening noise levels. Sadly, it did not work. Around 7-ish it started getting to the point where we were unable to converse and just concentrated on eating and trying to get outta there due to the auditory discomfort. I understand why restauranteurs insist on loud ambience (the research shows they sell more booze and turn over tables faster) and I don't understand why OSHA has not looked into the issue.
The lighting is dim and a bit disconcerting. I like a dim ambience, but this was too dark.
The service was pretentious. I have to laugh at some 20 year old twit who has an attitude when he is the one that is supposed to be serving me and making my experience pleasant. Maybe it was our age. Seventies is so uncool.
On to the food. The spicy tuna roll was very mediocre and its freshness was questionable. The edamame dumplings were excellent. The eggplant miso was cloyingly sweet and the brussel sprouts were amazing. But the prices were high for what we got.
We wanted to try the hot new place in town, but we were totally underwhelmed. We'll leave it to the youngsters who think that overpaying and shouting your way through a mixed quality meal is a cool thing to do.

too loud!  will not go again.  a 1:30 lunch should have been more quiet.  however, the music was blaring, to add to the noise level.  dining with friends to me means a chance to talk and eat good food.  talking was painful.  we had to shout to be heard.  and this was at a table in the front by the window.  it should have been more quiet that it was.
food can be great, but not worth the $$, in absense of ability to converse with friends.

No.  No no no.  I don't understand how anyone could enjoy this place. The food was fine, as was the service. But the tables are on top of each other and it is ridiculously too loud.  I could not hear my dining companion.   The noise ruined the dining experience.  Won't be back.

No matter how good the food was (and it was very good), couldn't get past how unbearably loud this place was.  Like, DECIBELS too loud. Our waitress lost her voice from working the night before... She had written the beer list out by hand so as to not repeat herself at screaming levels.  There are plenty of other bars in phila with good food, where you might also be able to communicate with your date and/or staff.

The food was tasty, but the music was SO LOUD we had to almost yell at each other to be heard.  We politely asked our server to turn down the volume. To our surprise she was neither accommodating nor understanding. She said the volume could not be lowered, per the owner's orders. Apparently the owner wants the music to be kept very loud to differentiate the restaurant from its predecessor.  Huh?  So much for the notion of customer satisfaction.  Not to mention the documented health hazards of sounds at high decibel levels.  Based on some of the other reviews I've read, it seems I'm not alone here.

Food is cool service and atmosphere is lousey. And very loud i asked to move seating twice and still a particular group of patrons was very loud with no one to ask them to quiet down a bit... the ppl who dined here that night were very upset.

What a disappointment!  For so long I have waited to try this adorable, charming place.  It came with such high recommendations.  Unfortunately the first bad sign was the LOUD music!!!  I could not hear my dining companion. I could not hear the waitperson's dialogue.  I am a  professional musician with very GOOD ears....and this was HORRIBLE.  I would have left immediately, but my companion was so looking forward to this place.  The food - overly salty. Nothing special. This place is another example of Emperor's new clothes.

The food was good. Decor, service and location were excellent.  

The sound level was deafening, however. 95 decibels constant (equivalent to a jackhammer at 50' or a subway train at 200') with occasional forays into 100 decibels (snowmobile, motorcycle - a level at which sustained exposure may result in hearing loss). Conversation was impossible.

I would return to this restaurant only if serious sound deadening measures were taken.

Good food, WAY TOO LOUD ATMOSPHERE.

I don't know who is in charge of the music but they should be fired or better yet be forced to get a bad tattoo. (Just kidding about the tattoo, most of the staff already have really bad tattoos.)

In all seriousness take some earplugs.This was the first time I left a restaurant with my ears ringing.

Some of the items on the menu are okay, but my overall experiences have never been stellar. First off, the place is SO LOUD! They should really invest in some sound-deafening panels on the walls and ceiling. I can barely hear the person sitting next to me and have to shout if there is a decent crowd. The awful acoustics completely ruin any chill experience you were trying to have. On another occasion, I had awful service from one of the downstairs bartenders. I was there to attend a musical event upstairs and wanted to get a beer at the downstairs bar. After waiting patiently for 5 minutes, I wasn't even acknowledged by the bartender. When I leaned in to say something, I was met with a "hold on, I have other guests..I'll get to you when I can". I just ended up going to the upstairs bar, which didn't have as much of a selection, but at least the bartender was fairly responsive. As far as the selection, there wasn't much of a variety - a LOT of IPA's and sours mostly. No pale ales or session-style beers, which was really frustrating. This place could be so much better, but it's just so mediocre.

This place has great food but the place was was too loud with obnoxious clientele that management let get out of hand which was totally disappointing. Several people asked to move their seats due to the one table which was a shame.  This restaurant was a family favorite and we doubt we will ever go back.

The food here is good - but the dining room is so small you're practically sitting on top of the people next to you. Also, it's incredibly noisy so you can barely carry on a conversation with the person you're with. On top of that, we were seated next to the kitchen, and I kept on getting bumped by waiters walking back and forth. I like to relax when I go to a restaurant, and it's really just not possible at this place due to the noise and close quarters. I guess some people like small, noisy, cramped BYOs, but this place just didn't do it for me.

My wife and I have dined here many times, since it's across the street from the Ritz movies.  The food has always been good and the decor is striking.  However, the noise level is extremely high due to all the hard surfaces -- lots of big windows, tile floor, etc.  Last night, there was also a wedding party and a separate bachelor party.  Both were behind curtains, but they were both noisy.  On the other hand, it would have been equally noisy if the same spaces were occupied by regular patrons.  Maybe the noise level would be appreciated by twenty-somethings, but not by most adults.
The drinks are creative and they offer a lot of top shelf liquors, but the prices are far too high compared to other good restaurants.
Overall, we won't be back, mainly because the noise level prevents relaxed enjoyment of the dining experience.

We were there Saturday night and it wasn't too busy.  The service was great and the food terrific. The reason I'm not giving it 4-5 stars is the NOISE.

We started of with the Caprese, it was fresh and delicious.  We split the rigatoni alla vodka and a margaretta pizza - both were wonderful.  Our server was delightful and attentive.

The major drawback was we couldn't even have a conversation because it was so noisy.  We were seated at a small table for two and we had to yell across the 24" table just to hear each other.  I'm hearing impaired, so I can only imagine how loud it was for my companion.  

If I visit again, I will sit outside where the street noise is much quieter.

Not a good experience. Ended up paying $250 for a dinner that took an hour and a half to arrive. 

We asked up front if it would be loud - the waiter assured us it would not be. I could not hear a single word anybody at the table said. It was the loudest restaurant I've been in, and louder than 90% of bars. 

Food, when it finally arrived, was mediocre. My dish was undercooked and cold (which is hard to pull off). Took 1 hour and forty minutes for the food. 

Really terrible experience. I cannot say enough poor things about this place. From the lying waiter to the bad food to the blasting, mediocre music, just not a good experience at all.

Very loud, "Top 40" rock music is blasted throughout the restaurant. We complained, and were told that the sound level is dictated by the corporate office and there is nothing they can do about it! We had to strain to hear each other. The friends, whom we came with, ordered coffee, which arrived cold. The waitress asked if everything was OK, and they said, "the coffee is cold." She answered, "That's great!" I don't know if she couldn't hear what they said, because of the loud music, or if she was just on autopilot. Too bad, because the food was good. But we won't be back.

你正在为餐饮评论召回系统建立逆向评测集。输入是同一个固定特征下的一批真实 Yelp 完整评论。

当前固定特征：quiet_environment
中文含义：环境从非常吵到非常安静
用户希望的方向：higher
满足要求的英文含义：["The restaurant is quiet, peaceful, calm, and suitable for conversation.", "Customers can talk comfortably without raising their voices."]
违反要求的英文含义：["The restaurant is loud and noisy, making conversation difficult.", "Customers cannot hear each other or need to shout over the noise."]

请从输入评论中恰好选择4条：2条明确满足要求，expected_direction=positive；2条明确违反要求，expected_direction=negative。每条评论最多使用一次。

要求：

1. query_text 必须是自然的中文找餐馆问题，只表达当前固定特征和指定方向。
2. query_text 不得出现商家名称、评论编号，也不得暗示已经知道答案。
3. requirement_text 用简短中文写清需要评论回答的要求。
4. evidence_span 必须逐字复制 review_text 中一段连续原文；不能翻译、改写、拼接或补字。
5. 原文必须能够直接证明正面或反面。泛泛的总体好评、差评、星级倾向和意思不清楚的句子不能使用。
6. 如果评论只提到相邻概念但不能证明当前特征，不要选择。
7. 4条样本的问题可以换自然说法，但不能改变指定特征和用户希望的方向。
8. 证据必须直接说明商家确实满足或违反要求。仅仅说“A比B更好/更差”、假设以后会怎样、或者只有在某个未满足条件下才成立，都不能当作明确证据。
9. 只返回下面这一种JSON结构，不要增加字段，不要返回Markdown代码块，不要解释：

{
  "drafts": [
    {
      "seed_review_id": "必须来自候选的review_id",
      "query_text": "自然中文问题",
      "requirement_text": "简短中文要求",
      "expected_direction": "positive或negative",
      "evidence_span": "从对应review_text逐字复制的连续原文"
    }
  ]
}

drafts必须恰好有4项，且必须是2项positive和2项negative。
